product_architecture.justification: Real multi-tier Express+React+Postgres+Redis with pack worker + scheduler; 13k LOC backend, 25 migrations.

frontend_ux.justification: Polished visuals, lazy-loaded ContentRouter, 60+ extracted views — but half of views bypass the API (Zustand-only).

backend_api_quality.justification: 26 route modules with validation, pagination, RLS-correct queries; some SQL correctness bugs remain.

data_model_quality.justification: Strong on projects/procurement/drawings; missing systems/subsystems/tag/equipment register breaks EPC hierarchy.

auth_and_authorization.justification: bcrypt + lockout + httpOnly/sameSite cookies + refresh rotation + jti revoke; dev JWT fallback + DB SSL rejectUnauthorized:false drag it down.

tenant_project_isolation.justification: Postgres RLS on every tenant table + set_config('app.current_tenant_id') per query — genuinely isolated.

security_hardening.justification: Helmet + rate limit + redacted audit bodies; but 7 high npm CVEs, broken lint, dev JWT fallback.

document_control_integrity.justification: documents/document_versions/drawings/drawing_revisions exist; not linked to tags/equipment — revision→execution traceability broken.

engineering_data_traceability.justification: No tag/equipment register; pack generation uses synthetic asset from pack title.

commissioning_workflow_completeness.justification: CxWorkflowView is explicitly client-side only; backend pack workflow is a separate narrower path.

test_pack_generation_quality.justification: templateEngine normalizes 20+ system types, produces MD + HTML; PDF is explicitly a stub.

turnover_dossier_readiness.justification: CxTurnoverItem exists only as client-side TypeScript type; no turnover/dossier tables in DB.

reliability_operational_maturity.justification: Graceful shutdown + SKIP LOCKED + backoff; but _failJob duplicate-column SQL means failed jobs never properly marked failed.

observability_logging.justification: pino structured logs, request IDs, audit_log, optional log drain, X-Request-ID header.

performance_scalability.justification: Lazy views, FTS + trgm indexes; tenantQuery per-request BEGIN/COMMIT churn, 715 KB recharts chunk.

testing_depth.justification: Reproduced 1037 failing / 4791 passing (vs CHANGELOG claim of 0 failing) — current suite not a regression signal.

deployment_readiness.justification: Build + Dockerfiles + Render deploy wired; no CI gate; README CI badge points to non-existent workflow.

mobile_offline_field_readiness.justification: OfflineIndicator + offlineQueue + fieldSync route exist; unverified end-to-end.

ai_safety_usefulness.justification: Forced tool_use schema, explicit no-invention rules, OEM tier; citations still self-reported by the model.

maintainability_code_health.justification: Real module extraction; but minified single-letter vars in JarvisCore, 125 TODO/FIXME, 5x-stale ratchet.

documentation_handover_readiness.justification: CHANGELOG detailed and current; README CI badge false, monolith comment 5x stale, ci.yml missing.

verdict_scope: demo only — not pilot, not field, not production
top_5_blockers: F01 CxWorkflowView does not persist (client-side only)
F03 No CI pipeline (only Render deploy)
